name: Single-Arm Chin-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with one hand in an underhand grip and your free arm clear of the bar.
Engage your lat by depressing your working shoulder blade and brace your entire core tightly to stop your body from spinning.
Pull forcefully upward through your working arm and back until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back to a full controlled hang, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Initiate every repetition by setting your shoulder blade down before bending your elbow.
Keep your chin level as you rise to avoid reaching for the bar with your neck.
